name: Ernesto de la Cruz's Grilled Seafood & Arroz Rojo Tomato Rice (Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Plaza de Coco (Día de los Muertos Night 2)
whyItWorks: Grilled scallops, shrimp, and white fish over soft Mexican rice provide high-quality lean protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the seafood grilled with salt and olive oil only (no chili-lime seasoning) and served over plain steamed white rice instead of spiced tomato rice.
watchOuts: Garlic/onion tomato seasoning in Arroz Rojo
